notes.announcementDescription: Declaration Of Results Of Remote E-Voting At The (01/2026-27) First EGM

notes.insight: At the same EGM (3 Jul 2026), Hardwyn shareholders approved a 2:5 bonus issue — 2 bonus equity shares of ₹1 face value for every 5 held, funded by capitalization of free reserves/retained earnings. This increases share count (and reduces per-share metrics proportionally) without diluting existing holders' proportional ownership or requiring cash — a shareholder-friendly capital action signaling management confidence in reserves. Combined with the same-day MOA amendment raising authorized capital to ₹70 crore, the company has created headroom for the bonus plus room for further corporate actions. Watch for the record date and credit date of the bonus shares.

Shareholders at the 3 Jul 2026 EGM regularized Yogesh Kumar Garg (DIN 02144584) as an Independent Director; he had first been appointed as an Additional (Independent, Non-Executive) Director effective 5 Jun 2026. This is a routine formalization of an already-serving director, not a new appointment or a departure — no governance red flag. No prior notes for this company. No specific follow-up needed.

notes.announcementTitle: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Amendments to Memorandum & Articles of Association
notes.insight: The same 3 Jul 2026 EGM approved altering Clause V (Capital Clause) of the Memorandum of Association, raising authorized share capital to ₹70,00,00,000 (70 crore equity shares of ₹1 face value each). This directly supports the concurrently-approved 2:5 bonus issue and gives the board room for further share issuance without another capital-clause amendment. Neutral on its own but reinforces the bullish bonus-issue signal from the same EGM. Watch whether the enlarged headroom is used for anything beyond the bonus issue (e.g. a future preferential allotment).
